description:
Planning-only handoff; no implementation or validation performed. Target lib/zaq/agent/retrieval.ex:125,145. Action reuse: not applicable; tests for existing Retrieval.ask/2 behavior only, no executable operation, Action, new tool, or production seam. E2E not applicable: no feature journey/UI change.

File to edit: test/zaq/agent/retrieval_coverage_test.exs (Zaq.Agent.RetrievalCoverageTest). Reuse Zaq.DataCase async:false, existing retrieval prompt-template setup, OpenAIStub.server/2 + chat_completion/1 + seed_llm_config/1 and start_supervised!/1. Keep existing nil/whitespace tests and lexical omission test in retrieval_test.exs; do not duplicate them or weaken assertions.

Step 1 (line 125): add table-driven public Retrieval.ask/2 examples, each handler returns HTTP 200 OpenAIStub.chat_completion with otherwise valid markdown Query/Language/Positive Answer/Negative Answer and Lexical Terms varied as: malformed JSON (["unterminated), JSON literal null, JSON object {"term":"x"}, JSON string "x", JSON empty array [], and optionally invalid mixed/whitespace members ["valid", 42] / ["valid", "   "] (latter exercise 121-123, not 125). Assert exact {:error, :invalid_lexical_terms} for each and no {:ok, ...}; for a positive control assert exact de-duplicated trimmed terms from ["  Paris  ", "Paris", "Saint-Saturnin"]. Minimal selection: malformed JSON and [] already drive line 125; extras guard fail-closed semantics. If broad malformed-input invariant merits property coverage, add focused bounded ExUnitProperties/StreamData generator for non-list JSON values and invalid lists through the same public contract, avoiding enormous network test loops or tautological expectations; concrete malformed case is mandatory.

Step 2 (line 145): investigate actual ReqLLM Response.text/1 and provider decode/build path BEFORE writing test. ReqLLM.Response.text/1 returns nil only when %ReqLLM.Response{message: nil}; OpenAIStub.chat_completion(nil) already has tests in retrieval_test.exs:144 and retrieval_coverage_test.exs:119, but OpenAI-compatible buffered builder constructs %Message{} even with nil wire content and Response.text then gives empty string. Try supported provider-specific HTTP fixture through OpenAIStub if its real generation path can return {:ok, %ReqLLM.Response{message: nil}}. Only if confirmed, add public ask/2 integration case asserting exact {:error, "Failed to process question: Empty assistant response content"} for nil response, distinct from whitespace. Never mock Generation/Response or add test-only production hooks. If impossible for supported successful generation, document evidence and propose removing unreachable normalized_text(nil) guard in a separately approved production cleanup (not a fabricated test); existing empty response cases preserve behavior. Cover branch only if genuine response exists.

Isolation/validation for implementer, NOT run by planner: fixture DB config is shared / OpenAIStub.seed_llm_config mutates persisted settings; retain existing async:false module with SQL sandbox isolation, supervised local server, no global Mox or network. Assert synchronous ask result, no sleeps/polling. Run mix test test/zaq/agent/retrieval_coverage_test.exs test/zaq/agent/retrieval_test.exs, mix q, review real branch coverage during authorized coverage phase and final mix precommit according to docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Do not weaken baseline. No new feature E2E required.
title: [zaq-aj2] Plan Retrieval coverage for malformed lexical terms and nil response
